# RebateAZ

> RebateAZ is a buyer commission rebate program for Arizona home buyers, run by licensed Arizona real estate agents with HomeSmart. Buyers get a full-service agent, and part of the commission the seller or builder pays comes back to the buyer as a credit at closing.

Key facts:
- Terms: the agent keeps 1.5% of the purchase price (minimum $4,500). Everything the seller or builder offers the buyer's agent above that is credited to the buyer at closing, up to 2% of the price. Program terms run through December 31, 2026.
- Example: on a $550,000 home where the seller offers 3% ($16,500), the buyer gets $8,250 back at closing.
- Full service: showings with no per-showing fees, comps and offer strategy, negotiation, inspections and repair requests, and closing. No upfront fees.
- Buyers can use any lender and any title company. The rebate is written into the buyer agreement, disclosed to the lender, and shown on the Closing Disclosure.
- Works on resale homes and new construction. On new builds the agent must be registered on the buyer's first visit to the builder.
- Areas: Phoenix metro, mainly Phoenix, North Phoenix, Chandler, Mesa, Gilbert, Tempe, Scottsdale and Queen Creek.
- Contact: text or call (602) 975-2727, info@rebateaz.com.
- Market data on the site comes from Maricopa County Recorder sales records (affidavits of property value), currently September 2025 through August 2026.
